description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin named 'style'. It includes plugin metadata, functions to generate control HTML, execute commands, handle node changes, and show a style properties window. It registers the plugin with TinyMCE at the end.

classes.name: TinyMCE_StylePlugin
classes.description: An object encapsulating the style plugin for TinyMCE, providing methods for plugin info, control HTML rendering, command execution, node change handling, and internal style properties management.

methods.name: getInfo()
methods.description: Returns metadata about the plugin, including long name, author info, version, and URLs.

methods.name: getControlHTML(cn)
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the style control button based on the control name.

methods.name: execCommand(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value)
methods.description: Executes commands such as opening the style properties dialog or setting element styles.

methods.name: handleNodeChange(editor_id, node, undo_index, undo_levels, visual_aid, any_selection)
methods.description: Handles browser node change events to toggle button states.

methods.name: _styleProps()
methods.description: Private method to open the style properties dialog for the focused element.

ctags.name: execCommand
ctags.pattern: /^	execCommand : function(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value) {$/

ctags.name: handleNodeChange
ctags.pattern: /^	handleNodeChange : function(editor_id, node, undo_index, undo_levels, visual_aid, any_selection/
